sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by characterisation of PV1 expression pattern in blood vessels of transgenic mice; no quantitative functional assay reported in these clips.
sites.rationale: PLVAP is a type II single-pass TM protein: its N-terminus (residues 1–26) is intracellular and its C-terminus (residue 442, Gly) is extracellular (ectodomain 49–442). The ledger clips name no residue for the 3xHA fusion, but because the N-terminus is cytoplasmic, the only extracellular terminus is residue 442; a tag confirmed to be on the cell surface (L2) must therefore sit after Gly442. Computed distance from the TM boundary (residue 48) to the C-terminus is 394 residues, well above the ≥3-residue minimum. Position is topology_derived, not validated, because no junction residue is stated in the ledger. Full-length mouse PV1 (PLVAP) fused to a 3xHA epitope tag was expressed under the VEC promoter in transgenic mice (VEC-PV1HA lines); L2 confirms surface display of the HA-tagged protein in endothelial cells of blood vessels.

sources.claim: The VEC-PV1HA transgenic cassette consisting of the VEC promoter, mouse PV1 fused to 3xHA epitope, SV40 polyA signal sequence and the 5′ 5kb of the VE Cadherin intron 1 was used for transgenic mouse generation at Dartmouth Transgenic Facility.

literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1 and L2) derive from the same paper (PMC3525343) and describe a single construct — full-length mouse PV1 with a 3xHA tag confirmed at the cell surface. Neither clip names a residue number or a specific loop for the tag. PLVAP has exactly one extracellular terminus (C-terminus, residue 442); the intracellular N-terminus (1–26) is ruled out by the confirmed surface display. No internal ectodomain loop is named in the ledger, so no internal site can be proposed. The N-terminal intracellular position is noted conceptually but not listed in other_positions because the ledger does not report it as a tested insertion site.
